patreon.campaign.description: Reads your Patreon campaign as Cuebot knows it (from the API when connected, else from webhooks).
patreon.campaign.returns: name, currency, patronCount, paidCount, monthly (paying patrons' pledges per month added up), connected and lastSync.

patreon.tiers.description: Lists the Patreon tiers Cuebot knows.
patreon.tiers.returns: A list of tiers with id, title, amount and published.

patreon.patron.description: Finds the Patreon patron linked to a viewer (patrons who linked Twitch, YouTube or Discord on Patreon).

parameters.userName: Optional. The viewer's name, for Twitch links made by name.

patreon.patron.returns: name, status, tier, monthly, currency, since and paying; or null when the viewer is not a known patron.

patreon.members.description: Says how many Patreon members Cuebot knows and whether the list came from a full sync.

patreon.sync.description: Reads the Patreon member list now. Needs the Patreon API connected on the Webhooks page.
patreon.sync.returns: A status line, like "Synced 12 Patreon member(s)."
